derivation_disclosure: Composed after the Japan r7.22 DINOv2 open failure and the independent pre-existing r7.11 chromatic-marker pass. Japan and all earlier sources are derivation evidence and cannot count as the next prospective fusion challenge.

general_static_dinov2.feature_contract: exactly the bound r7.22 DINOv2 regional pair contract

chromatic_construction_marker.feature_contract: exactly the bound r7.11 chromatic marker contract
chromatic_construction_marker.positive_rule: high_saturation_fraction > dark_fraction then frozen 2-of-3 lifecycle entry
chromatic_construction_marker.close_rule: five consecutive absent samples after an opened event

fusion.open_rule: OR over independent positive evidence channels
fusion.close_rule: every channel that opened the event must independently confirm close
fusion.conflict_rule: keep present or uncertain; never clear on conflict
